    def test_edit_non_admin(sheet_name, test_name, prompt, section_name, entry_name, generate, evaluation_metrice, evaluation_model, client, ragmetric, view_helpers_factory):
        """
        Test to ensure non-admin users cannot edit configuration settings.
        This test is parametrized for 2 random rows per sheet.
        """
        import ast
        import uuid
        import io, sys, datetime
        allure.dynamic.parent_suite(sheet_name)
        allure.dynamic.suite("edit_non_admin")
        allure.dynamic.sub_suite(test_name)
        exec_time = datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()
        allure.attach(exec_time, name="Execution Time", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
        stdout_capture = io.StringIO()
        old_stdout = sys.stdout
        sys.stdout = stdout_capture
        try:
            # Load section and item descriptions from Excel
            try:
                sections_data = load_sections()
            except Exception:
                sections_data = []
            section_desc = None
            for s in sections_data:
                if s.get('SECTION_NAME') == section_name:
                    section_desc = s.get('SECTION_DESC')
                    break
    
            try:
                entries_data = load_entries()
            except Exception:
                entries_data = []
            item_desc = None
            for e in entries_data:
                if e.get('ENTRY_NAME') == entry_name:
                    item_desc = e.get('ITEM_DESC')
                    break
    
            value = client.get_config_entry(section_name, entry_name, user_type="Non Admin")
            allure.attach(str(value), name="Original Config Value", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
            prompt = generate.update_query(section_name=section_name, entry_name=entry_name, section_desc=section_desc or "", item_desc=item_desc or "")
            allure.attach(str(prompt), name="Update Prompt", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
            chat_id = client.create_chat()
            allure.attach(chat_id, name="Chat ID", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
            ask_result = client.ask(chat_id=chat_id, user_query=prompt, user_type="Non Admin")
            text_response = ask_result["text_response"]
            metadata = ask_result.get("metadata")
            latency = ask_result.get("latency")
            allure.attach(str(metadata), name="Metadata", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
            if metadata and metadata.get("type") in ["confirm", "select"]:
                helpers = view_helpers_factory(chat_id, section_name, entry_name, section_desc or "", item_desc or "")
                helpers.handle_non_admin_edit_conversational_flow(
                    first_response=text_response,
                    prompt_used=prompt,
                    original_value=value,
                    index=0,
                    max_turns=3
                )
            else:
                allure.attach(str(latency), name="Latency", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                allure.attach(str(text_response), name="LLM Response", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                # Expect an 'error' metadata for non-admin updates; restore if accidental success
                helpers = view_helpers_factory(chat_id, section_name, entry_name, section_desc or "", item_desc or "")
                if metadata:
                    helpers.validate_metadata_match(metadata)
                    if metadata.get("type") == "success":
                        helpers.validate_metadata_and_restore_db(metadata, user_type="Admin")
                    assert metadata.get("type") == "error", (
                        f"Expected 'error' metadata for non-admin edit, got: {metadata.get('type')}\nMetadata: {metadata}")
                updated_value = client.get_config_entry(section_name, entry_name, user_type="Non Admin")
                if updated_value != value:
                    restore_success = client.update_config_entry_value(value, user_type="Admin")
                    allure.attach(str(updated_value), name="Updated Config Value", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                    allure.attach(str(restore_success), name="Restored DB value to original", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                assert updated_value == value, (
                    f"Non-admin user was able to update the DB value, which should not be allowed.\nPrompt: {prompt}\nDB Value: {updated_value}")
                metrice = ragmetric("AccessDeniedMetric")
                test_case = LLMTestCase(
                    input=prompt,
                    actual_output=text_response
                )
                metrice.measure(test_case)
                allure.attach(str(metrice.score), name="Score", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                allure.attach(str(metrice.reason), name="Reason", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
